## Description

A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Reproduction

Steps to reproduce the behavior, including the exact `codepatrol` command and
the content of the relevant result files (`spec.json`, `plan.json`, etc.).

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened, including the error code and message from stderr.

## Environment

- Node version (`node --version`)
- Operating system
- CodePatrol version (`codepatrol --version`)
